records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: On-demand network access to scalable compute, storage, databases, and applications with measured usage. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Business, process, culture, and customer-experience change enabled by digital technology—not merely moving servers"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Elasticity"?
records.A: The ability of a system to increase or decrease capacity to handle a different workload.
records.B: The ability to change resources, technologies, or architectures quickly as requirements evolve.
records.C: Rapid or automatic adjustment of resources to match actual demand, including scaling back after a peak.
records.D: Applications designed for cloud elasticity, automation, managed services, microservices, and distributed architectures.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: A design that keeps a service accessible when an individual component or zone fails. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Provider-operated, multi-tenant cloud infrastructure with logical isolation and rapid access to global scale"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Hybrid cloud"?
records.A: A cloud environment dedicated to one organization, hosted on-premises or by a third party.
records.B: An interconnected combination of public cloud and private or on-premises environments.
records.C: The coordinated use of public cloud services from more than one cloud provider.
records.D: Provider-operated, multi-tenant cloud infrastructure with logical isolation and rapid access to global scale.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: The provider manages hardware and virtualization; the customer manages the operating system, applications, data, and access. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A complete provider-managed application consumed by users, commonly through a browser"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Shared responsibility model"?
records.A: Security and operational duties are divided between the cloud provider and the customer; customer responsibility never disappears.
records.B: A complete provider-managed application consumed by users, commonly through a browser.
records.C: A numeric network identifier used to locate an interface and route traffic to a resource.
records.D: A managed application platform where the provider handles more infrastructure and runtime operations.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: An independent geographic area containing multiple Google Cloud zones. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "The time taken for a request or packet to travel and receive a response; it is a delay measurement"?

A company has the following requirement: Raw facts from transactions, interactions, sensors, documents, or processes that create value when governed and analyzed. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Data with keys, tags, or flexible fields but without a rigid relational schema, such as JSON"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Data warehouse"?
records.A: An organized system for an application's operational transactions, searches, and updates.
records.B: A centralized system optimized for large-scale analytics and reporting across multiple data sources.
records.C: A repository for large volumes of raw data of many types, retained for exploration and processing.
records.D: Data aggregated by an outside party that may have no direct relationship with the people represented.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Non-relational data models with flexible schemas, selected for particular scale, speed, or distribution requirements. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A declarative standard language used to define, query, and manipulate relational or analytical data"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Streaming analytics"?
records.A: Continuous processing and analysis of events as they arrive for time-sensitive decisions.
records.B: Periodic processing of a collection of accumulated data, suitable when immediate results are unnecessary.
records.C: The ability to move and use data across tools and platforms through open formats and interfaces.
records.D: Roles, policies, quality, access, lifecycle, and accountability that make data trustworthy and compliant.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Low-cost Cloud Storage class for data accessed roughly once a month, with a 30-day minimum duration. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Cloud Storage feature that automatically transitions objects between storage classes based on access patterns"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Spanner"?
records.A: Managed relational databases for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server with familiar engines and reduced administration.
records.B: A fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible database optimized for demanding enterprise transactional and analytical workloads.
records.C: Cloud Storage feature that automatically transitions objects between storage classes based on access patterns.
records.D: A fully managed relational database combining strong consistency, SQL, and horizontal global scale.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: A serverless document database with real-time synchronization for web and mobile applications. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A global asynchronous messaging service that decouples event producers from consumers"?

A company has the following requirement: Computer systems performing tasks that normally require human intelligence, including perception, language, and decision support. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A subset of AI in which models learn patterns from data instead of relying only on explicit rules"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Agentic AI"?
records.A: AI systems that plan, use tools, take multi-step actions, and adapt toward a goal with appropriate controls.
records.B: AI that creates new content such as text, images, audio, video, or code from learned patterns.
records.C: Examining data to discover patterns, answer questions, and support decisions.
records.D: A subset of AI in which models learn patterns from data instead of relying only on explicit rules.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Governed reports, metrics, dashboards, and exploration used to understand business performance. Which option BEST fits this requirement?

Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Designing and operating AI with fairness, privacy, safety, accountability, transparency, and appropriate human oversight"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Pretrained API"?
records.A: Methods that help people understand why a model produced a prediction or recommendation.
records.B: Tools that automate parts of custom model development while using an organization's own labeled data.
records.C: Designing and operating AI with fairness, privacy, safety, accountability, transparency, and appropriate human oversight.
records.D: A ready-to-use AI service for a common task that requires little or no custom model training.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: A model designed and trained for a specialized requirement when ready-made solutions are insufficient. Which option BEST fits this requirement?

Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "An enterprise platform for discovering, creating, governing, and using AI agents across organizational data and workflows"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Cloud Vision API"?
records.A: APIs and developer capabilities for programmatically building and integrating enterprise agents.
records.B: A pretrained service for translating text between supported languages.
records.C: A pretrained API that detects and classifies content, text, and objects in images.
records.D: A low-code environment for building and configuring enterprise AI agents.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: A pretrained service that transcribes spoken audio into written text. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Functionality for creating and using machine-learning models with SQL directly in BigQuery"?
A company has the following requirement: An application, service, process, or group of resources that performs a business or technical function. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Decommissioning a workload that no longer provides enough business value"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Rehost (lift and shift)"?
records.A: Keeping a workload in its current environment for now because migration is not yet justified or possible.
records.B: Moving a workload while making limited optimizations, often by adopting managed services.
records.C: Decommissioning a workload that no longer provides enough business value.
records.D: Moving a workload to cloud infrastructure with minimal application changes.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: A software-defined computer with its own operating system, providing infrastructure-level control. Which option BEST fits this requirement?

Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A lightweight package containing an application and its dependencies while sharing the host operating-system kernel"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Microservices"?
records.A: Packaging applications and dependencies into portable, consistent container images.
records.B: A model in which the provider manages infrastructure and scaling while the customer focuses on code or containers.
records.C: An architecture of small, independently deployable services communicating through APIs.
records.D: A lightweight package containing an application and its dependencies while sharing the host operating-system kernel.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Automatically adding or removing capacity according to demand or metrics. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A defined interface that allows software systems to request functions or exchange data"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Cloud Run"?
records.A: Google Cloud infrastructure-as-a-service virtual machines with operating-system and machine-level control.
records.B: A fully managed serverless platform for running containerized applications and services.
records.C: Event-driven functions on Cloud Run infrastructure for small units of code without server management.
records.D: The earlier product name for Google's event-driven functions; newer exam material emphasizes Cloud Run functions.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Google Cloud's managed Kubernetes service for container orchestration with Kubernetes control and portability. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A full-lifecycle API management platform for securing, publishing, analyzing, and monetizing APIs"?
A company has the following requirement: An administrative, technical, or physical safeguard that reduces a security risk. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Ensuring systems and data are accessible to authorized users when needed"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Security by default"?
records.A: Never trust implicitly; continuously verify identity, device, context, and policy for each access decision.
records.B: Security requirements and threat considerations are built into architecture and development from the beginning.
records.C: Secure settings and protections are enabled by default so the safer behavior requires no extra action.
records.D: Granting only the minimum permissions required, for only as long as they are needed.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Multiple independent security layers so that failure of one control does not expose the entire system. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Verifying who a user, service, or device claims to be"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Identity and Access Management (IAM)"?
records.A: Requiring two or more independent verification factors to reduce account-compromise risk.
records.B: Managing identities, roles, and permissions to control access to Google Cloud resources.
records.C: Fraudulent messages or sites designed to trick people into revealing credentials or taking unsafe actions.
records.D: Recording and reviewing who did what, where, and when for accountability and investigation.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: An unsafe resource or access setting that unintentionally exposes data or systems. Which option BEST fits this requirement?

Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "A cloud-native security operations platform for ingesting telemetry, detecting threats, investigating, and responding"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Cloud Armor"?
records.A: DDoS protection and web application firewall controls for applications behind supported Google Cloud load balancers.
records.B: Dedicated or partner private connectivity from an external network to Google Cloud with high capacity and predictable performance.
records.C: Centralized collection, search, storage, analysis, and routing of logs from resources and applications.
records.D: Encrypted IPsec connectivity over the public internet between networks.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Capabilities for discovering, assessing, and protecting AI assets and workloads across their lifecycle. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
A company has the following requirement: Upfront investment in long-lived assets such as servers, facilities, and equipment. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "The top of the Google Cloud resource hierarchy, representing the enterprise and enabling organization-wide policy"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Resource quota"?
records.A: A limit on resource creation or consumption that protects capacity, security, and spending.
records.B: Policies applied at higher hierarchy levels flow down to folders, projects, and resources.
records.C: A notification trigger when actual or forecast spending reaches a percentage of a defined budget.
records.D: A cloud object such as a VM, bucket, dataset, or service, usually associated with a project.

records.Question (English): A company has the following requirement: Maintaining copies of data or state across locations to support availability and continuity. Which option BEST fits this requirement?
Which concept or service is MOST accurately described by the following statement: "Continuous code-level analysis of CPU and memory consumption to improve performance and cost"?
What is the PRIMARY purpose or exam association of "Service level objective (SLO)"?
records.A: A measured value of service behavior, such as latency, availability, or error rate.
records.B: A customer-facing contractual service commitment that may include remedies if it is missed.
records.C: Applying software-engineering principles to operations using measurable reliability targets and automation.
records.D: A target value for an SLI over a period, used internally to guide reliability work.
